column8: Logical forwarded target and physical proxy remain distinct, and cancellation wins before a forwarded dispatch is observed. The complete three-store forwarding and failure matrix remains open.
A recovered route retries through the canonical selector while immutable attempt evidence prevents a stale response from closing a replacement channel. Live multi-store recovery stress remains open.
Direct retry closes only the exact observed channel generation and a delayed failure cannot close its replacement. The full synchronous restart timing matrix remains open.
The BatchCommands-first coordinator carries publication evidence into the same exact-generation retry policy. The complete upstream asynchronous restart matrix remains open.
A current direct mismatch closes the observed version and reselects, while stale evidence cannot mutate a newer channel. The full known-store replacement matrix remains open.

Async publication preserves the exact physical identity used by direct mismatch recovery and does not query mutable pool state after completion. The full upstream async replacement matrix remains open.
Caller cancellation is terminal before StoreNotMatch can close a channel, invalidate a route, reload PD, or redispatch. The complete synchronous cancellation race matrix remains open.
Caller cancellation wins after async completion publication but before StoreNotMatch mutation or retry. The complete upstream asynchronous cancellation race matrix remains open.

Behavioral tests cover current and stale direct mismatch, current and stale forwarded mismatch, two logical targets sharing one proxy, and cancellation precedence. The exhaustive upstream region-request error matrix remains open.
